verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's API docs state that an OpenAPI 3.1 specification is downloadable as a YAML file, with a Postman collection also offered. The probe's 404s only cover guessed JSON paths (openapi.json/swagger.json), not the documented YAML link, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the YAML file actually downloads and parses, and independent corroboration of the spec's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Want to check our OpenAPI 3.1 specification? You can download our yaml file right here. You can also try our Postman collection.
